title: Basic credentials whose password has non-ASCII characters
summary: A synthetic Basic token whose decoded user-pass holds UTF-8 multibyte characters in the password.
rationale: The encoding of the user-pass is not defined by the scheme, so the encoded token is the only stable source form; its decoded octets may be UTF-8 or a legacy encoding, which is a downstream decoding question, not a reason to narrow the source span.

expectation.rationale: Flag, with the whole token as the extent. RFC 7617 leaves the default character encoding undefined and gives a UTF-8 example whose Base64 token is still an ordinary token68.

sources.supports: this specification continues to leave the default encoding undefined, as long as it is compatible with US-ASCII
a user-pass of 'test:123' plus U+00A3 encoded as UTF-8 is carried as Base64 in an ordinary Authorization header

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Authored from the cited standards read on 2026-10-03, before any scanner was consulted. All values are synthetic and were not tested against any service. Header coalescing, parser and action policy, decoded-token mapping and product masking stay with the downstream repositories.
